- 新增“实践应用”章节，系统化展示核心架构设计原则在 Python 代码中的实现范例。

Claude Code 架构设计模式 Skill 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Added comprehensive documentation (SKILL.md) summarizing key architecture principles from the Claude Code source code leak.
- Outlined 7 core design patterns, including Initiative/Execution separation, read/write concurrency, on-demand tool loading, and more.
- Documented security practices like fail-closed defaults and undercover mode.
- Included analysis of hidden features and code safety protocols found in the leaked source.
- Compiled core references related to the 2026 source leak events.
